description: Submit a long audio file (url or uploadId) as an async job: 0.005 USDC per started minute (exact, x402 Base USDC), up to 180 min. Without payment returns PaymentRequired with the exact price; pay via _meta["x402/payment"]. First segment is transcribed before settlement; then poll speech_job_status or get a signed webhook.

durationSeconds.description: Declared duration hint (can only raise the price).

summary.description: Include a short summary when done.

uploadId.description: job_… id from speech_job_upload_url after the PUT.

url.description: HTTPS direct media URL you have the right to process (not a platform page).

webhook.description: Optional public https URL for a signed job.done callback.

name: speech_job_submit
title: Async long-file transcript job (paid)
